name: Pilgrim Sailing
summary: Sunset and lunchtime sailing cruises and private charters on Pilgrim, a 58-foot sailing yacht, from Nelly Bay on Magnetic Island near Townsville. Shared cruises carry a maximum of 12 guests, with local food and drinks included. Paul and Clare Ley started Pilgrim Sailing on Sydney Harbour in 2010 and have run it from Magnetic Island since 2020.
standouts: Family owned and operated, started in 2010 by Paul and Clare Ley
Real sailing on a classic 58-foot yacht, sails up and engine off

trips.title: Lunchtime Sailing Cruise
trips.summary: A four hour shared sailing cruise on Pilgrim from Nelly Bay to a sheltered bay on Magnetic Island, usually Radical, Florence or Arthur Bay. At anchor there is time to swim, float on an inflatable mat, walk the beach or relax on board while a local prawn and antipasto lunch is served. Wine, local beer and soft drinks are included.
highlights: Sailing along the island coast, then time at anchor in a bay
Local prawn and antipasto lunch, with vegetarian and gluten free options
Wine, local beer and soft drinks included
Shared with other guests, maximum 12 on board

Snorkelling is only possible in suitable conditions, for confident swimmers with previous snorkelling experience, and needs a signed waiver. There are steps to board, a steep staircase to the toilet and a ladder to enter the water.
trips.checkNotes: Itinerary on the trip page: meet the crew 10:00, set sail 10:15, at anchor 11:15 to 1:15, back at Nelly Bay by about 2:15pm. The FAQ on the Plan Your Experience and All Experiences pages says around an hour and a half at anchor, the trip page itinerary shows two hours. Child price amounts are not shown on the page (only the child age limit), so only the adult from price is recorded; the exact prices sit in the booking calendar, which was not opened. Minimum numbers conflict: the trip page says minimum 4 guests, the Terms page says minimum six adults for Lunchtime Cruises. Two booking links on the page: LUN-DAY-M is the Book Now button, LUN-DAY-T is Book Now Departing Townsville (adds optional return SeaLink ferry tickets, guests catch the 9.30am ferry). Both go to the operator's own booking subdomain, not Rezdy, and were not opened. Page says to call 0424 296406 for next day bookings when the calendar shows no availability. When southeasterly winds blow, cruises can leave from Horseshoe Bay instead (see operator notes). Not a snorkel tour: the site states it does not offer snorkelling tours.

trips.title: Sip & Sail Sunset Cruise
trips.summary: A shared sunset sail of 1.5 to 2 hours on Pilgrim across Cleveland Bay, leaving from Nelly Bay on Magnetic Island. Wine, local beer or non-alcoholic drinks are included, with a local cheese platter and the crew's pumpkin chutney. Once a month the cruise runs about 30 minutes longer to watch the full moon rise.

Unlimited Australian organic wines, local beers or non-alcoholic drinks

trips.title: Private Day Charter
trips.summary: Exclusive use of Pilgrim for a four hour, five hour or Day to Dusk charter from Nelly Bay on Magnetic Island. The day includes a sail along the coast, a couple of hours at anchor in a quiet bay, and a local prawn and antipasto lunch with drinks. Day to Dusk charters finish with a sunset sail. Groups of up to 16 are catered for online, and the yacht is licensed for 24.

Optional extras include champagne, snorkel hire, a beach cabana and a guided walk with a sail

trips.title: Gourmet Picnic on a Remote Beach (Guided)
trips.summary: A small, fast boat takes guests from Nelly Bay to a quiet beach on Magnetic Island, where the crew sets up a gourmet picnic with beverages, a rug and cabana shade. Guests spend about two hours on the beach to swim and relax, and the skipper returns to pack up and bring them back. It is arranged by email or phone.

About two hours on the beach with the setup done for you
Gourmet picnic and beverages, cabana shade and picnic rug
Picnic menus can be adjusted for dietary requirements

checkNotes: LOCATION MISMATCH: our list described this operator as Airlie Beach and the Whitsundays with small-boat snorkel charters. The website is for Magnetic Island, off Townsville (Nelly Bay), and says it does not offer snorkelling tours (guests may snorkel with their own gear when conditions allow). Please confirm this is the right operator. BOOKING SYSTEM: bookings run on bookings.pilgrimsailing.com.au, the operator's own booking subdomain, which resolves to a customlinc.com.au host. It is not Rezdy, so rezdyAlias is null. Those booking pages were not opened. The two sailing cruises have their own per-trip links (LUN-DAY-M, LUN-DAY-T, SIP-SUN-M, SIP-SUN-T); the private charters link only to the Private category list. NOT INCLUDED AS TRIPS: (1) Pilgrim Adventures small boat tours on Sandy, a 5.2 metre RIB. The Tours & Cruises page describes Circumnavigate Magnetic Island (five hours, adds a full circuit and a morning tea stop) and Three Bays in Three Ways (four hours, three stops to swim, snorkel or explore, local prawn and antipasto picnic, a drink, snorkel gear, stinger suits, picnic rug and cabana), both private only for 2 to 4 guests. However their own pages (/experiences/p/circumnavigate-tour and /experiences/p/three-bays-tour) return 404, they are missing from the All Experiences list, and no price is shown, so it is unclear whether they are currently sold. The Terms and Plan Your Experience pages still mention Pilgrim Adventures (morning 8:15 or 8:30 and afternoon 2pm departures, minimum two adults). Ask the operator. (2) Picnic on the Island (self-guided), a gourmet picnic for two collected or delivered on land, ordered by 5pm the night before; no price shown; not on the water. (3) Amphibious Tours: a vessel under construction with a Queensland Government grant, expected launch mid 2027, not bookable. (4) An unlinked Christmas parties page (/christmas-parties2) lists corporate charter packages with prices (for example Signature Day Charter $3,750 for up to 8, Executive Entertainer Charter $279 per person, Day to Dusk $299 per person, Trek & Sail $279 per person, Sail & Beach $329 per person, Sip & Sail with Tan Lines $159 per person). It uses the promo code XMAS25 and a booking cut-off of 31 October, so it looks like last season's page; not captured. Trek & Sail is run with a partner, Destination Adventure. WEATHER AND DEPARTURE POINT: when southeasterly winds blow, all cruises and charters can run from Horseshoe Bay instead of Nelly Bay, boarding by tender (see /horseshoe-bay-departures). Guests are told by the operator. SEASON: no operating season is stated. The contact page says they sail most days, weather permitting, and stinger suits are provided from November to May, so season is null on every trip. ROUTE: Pilgrim does not pick up from Townsville; ferry tickets with SeaLink (about 20 to 25 minutes) can be added as an extra on the cruises, and the meeting point is a short walk from the ferry terminal. CANCELLATION (Terms page): shared cruises can be refunded or rescheduled once if cancelled 48 hours or more before departure; private charters take a deposit with final payment 14 days before, with deposit and refund rules at 14 days and 7 days (the Terms page states the deposit as a percentage). The operator cancels with refund, credit or reschedule for weather or safety. CERTIFICATIONS AND BADGES: the home page shows badge images (EarthCheck certified and Earth Rating 2024, Best of Queensland Experience 2025 and 2026 Gold, 2025 Tourism Awards winner badges for Excellence in Sustainability and New Tourism Experience, Tripadvisor Awards, Master Reef Guide, Eco Guide certified, Sustainable Tourism Accredited Business). Only the EarthCheck certification (August 2024) is repeated in the text; the other badges are image only and were not used as standouts. The home page also says 5-star guest reviews; not repeated. OTHER: the site shows a drinks and food list by named local suppliers and charities it supports, which is not used. The yacht Pilgrim is a 58 foot (17.7 metre) sloop built in 1992 and licensed for 24 guests; shared cruises are capped at 12. Phone is shown as +61 424 296 406 and 0424 296406; the contact page offers WhatsApp and text; clare@pilgrimsailing.com.au appears as the email on the private charter and picnic enquiry links; the general address is info@pilgrimsailing.com.au. The address 123 Sooning St, Nelly Bay is the footer location; guests meet at Peppers Blue on Blue Resort, Nelly Bay, beside the Boardwalk Restaurant.
